sources.title: Similipal Tiger Reserve · Entry Gates
sources.note: Similipal Tiger Reserve, Entry Gates, checked 20 October 2026: Kaliani/Jashipur and Pithabata/Baripada. These pairings do not confirm opening, availability or a particular camp route.

locators.detail-0: Kaliani Gate paragraph: Jashipur-side entry; Pithabata Gate paragraph: Baripada-side entry. The options reuse these pairings.
locators.options: Gate names and side pairings are factual; fit, transport and check fields are original conditional planning advice.

sources.inspection: Actual full page recovered through the www host on 20 October 2026. The non-www URL returned a web cache miss. No access barrier bypassed.
limits: No current time, quota, opening status, shortest journey or exhaustive list of gates claimed.
No quiet-forest-facing or promotional language imported.

sources.title: Similipal Tiger Reserve · Routes and Access
sources.note: Similipal Tiger Reserve, Routes & Access, checked 20 October 2026: vehicle eligibility, rough tracks, certified guides and separate guide fees. Recheck requirements for your visit.

locators.detail-2: LMV only; Rough tracks; Certified guide required; Keep to the route. The exact 180 mm threshold was read but not adopted as standalone vehicle approval.

sources.inspection: Actual full page opened on 20 October 2026. It specifies LMV clearance of 180 mm, excludes listed vehicle classes, requires a guide in the vehicle and lists a separate fee. Public prose uses the broader requirement and asks for confirmation.
limits: No legal interpretation, vehicle inspection, route completion time, guide availability, fee amount or accessibility assurance.
